कौंकः, कौंकणः (pl.) N. of a
country and its people or rulers; (see
कोंकण).

कौंकः, कौंकणः (pl.) N. of a
country and its people or rulers; (see
कोंकण).

कौंजर a. Belonging to an
elephant.

कौंतिकः [कुंतः प्रहरणमस्य ठञ्] A
spearman, lancer.

कौंतेयः [कुंत्याः अपत्यं ढक्] ‘Son of
Kuntī’, an epithet of Yudhiṣṭhira,
Bhīma or Arjuna.
